meta.title: Yanyan Toolkit
meta.description: One bundle with four independently toggleable plugins: Plugin Update (checks local and registry plugin versions, updates them one by one), Session Management (auto-archive / auto-delete, single and batch delete, reusing the existing dsh-session-archive package), Subagent Management (session header tab, permanent per-row delete with log root-cause removal + in-memory projection fix, clean all idle, and idle-time auto-cleanup), and Icon Generator (center-crops an uploaded image and generates an icon.svg fitted for the plugin list artwork slot). Install this one package to get all four.
